description: Submit evidence for one of your open quest attempts. visibility controls who can see it and defaults to private — see that parameter's description before choosing anything wider.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

visibility.description: Who can see this evidence. Optional; defaults to private. On a ROOM quest, "shared" means everyone else running that same quest can read it — ask the person before choosing it, since it makes their words visible to strangers. On a SOLO quest nobody else holds an attempt, so "shared" there shows it to no one. "public" means every signed-in user on the site, not just people on this quest, on either kind of quest.

name: submit_evidence
title: Submit Evidence
